reason: The README clearly describes a Windows Electron desktop wrapper that packages DeepSeek Harness, manages its local service process, and provides a desktop window, tray controls, runtime, and workspace configuration.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 封装为易于安装和使用的 Windows 桌面应用。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop application that packages DeepSeek Harness Web UI with bundled runtime and local service management.

capabilities: Packages and launches a Windows desktop application using Electron
Starts and manages a local DeepSeek Harness service process
Bundles and runs a portable Node.js runtime
Opens a local web UI in a desktop window
May detect or prompt installation of system Node.js when the bundled runtime is unavailable
Supports configuration of a DeepSeek API key for the underlying service
